docstring_rule.why: builds on apply_coupon_float and follows its docstring: floats, a floor of zero, any percentage up to 100%

float_math.why: gets the floor and the cap right but computes in floats, so 10% off 19.95 is 17.95

floor_zero.why: keeps the old docstring's floor of zero instead of 1.00

uncapped.why: takes the whole percentage off, as the old docstring allows, instead of at most 50%

floor_amounts_only.why: floors only amount coupons at 1.00, so 45% off 1.80 leaves 0.99
